title: The Broken Crayon in the Class Tin
youtube_title: The Broken Crayon in the Class Tin | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Owning a mistake is how trust grows back.
summary: At a cottage hallway of hooks, rugs, and boots, Pilar is tangled up with a broken crayon returned to the tin as if it were whole and almost hides it. Pilar tells the baker the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
